title: Heartbeat-end: Veiled Listening Secret (7c8e8e) — Director-role end by intent at Moment 2; monitors stopped; closeout broadcast posted
body: Director-role end by intent (PDR-064 Moment 2, event 0a3d08ff). Heartbeat loop bxkou7kal and comms watcher b9v5q8d4z stopped explicitly at wake.
